ios.desc:
Chronic pain sucks. Our team felt this firsthand, and enlisted a world class team of pain experts to design a 12-week curated program designed to take you from pain state, to flow state

“Flowly helps manage not only the physical aspects of living with pain and anxiety, but also offers invaluable support to overcome the mental challenges that come along with it.” -Dr. Aman Mahajan, Chair of Perioperative Medicine at University of Pittsburgh Medical Center

“Flowly’s virtual worlds help users reclaim a sense of calm and safety at the emotional and physical level, thus allowing them to reduce activation in their nervous system and pain in their body.” -Pierre Etienne-Vannier, Mind-Body Practitioner

*How Does It Work?*

Flowly’s Healing from Pain Program is a curated 12-week program with new lessons, daily trainings, and access to a coach included

Weeks 1-4: Building the Foundation
In your first week, you will receive a Kit that includes a VR headset and a HR sensor so you can engage in your daily VR nervous system training. You will also schedule your first of three Flowly Coaching sessions to set your goals for the program, design your Flowly routine moving forward, and answer any questions you might have

Weeks 5-8: Cultivating Intrinsic Brain-Body Regulation
Engage in trainings that utilize your nervous system to take control of various psychological and emotional aspects of your chronic pain experience. All while discovering new environments and tools to create physical safety. Meet with your Flowly coach for your second session to check in on progress and goals

Weeks 9-12: Establishing Enduring Practice
Reinforcing all the training you have accomplished so far, we will put together all the tools and learnings into a daily ritual that best fits your life now, but most importantly, your life and dreams moving forward. You will also meet with your coach for your last session to wrap up your program and establish your steps moving forward

All throughout the program, you will have access to:
* Bubbles: virtual small support groups where heroes can connect with one another and engage in activities to do with improving their health
* Workshops: with health experts and specialists on specific educational health topics
* Tools: 2D breathwork guides, educational articles, and more in the Resources tab in-app
* Forum: a community forum where heroes can share their experiences and questions

quotes.text:
Hey HN! This is Celine, Julien, and Narae of Flowly (https://www.flowly.world/). Flowly is an app that combines VR and biofeedback training to help people manage pain, reduce anxiety, and increase relaxation (we send every member a VR headset and Realtime HR Sensor to use). We started this company to serve the 1 in 3 Americans who suffer from chronic pain and we’re now backed by the NIH and National Institute of Drug Abuse.

The opioid crisis has exposed how prevalent chronic pain is and how inaccessible and limited pain management solutions are today. Many pain management tools don't address all aspects of pain because pain encompasses more than physical pain: the top symptoms of chronic pain actually include anxiety, depression, and feelings of social isolation. In other words, chronic pain is a bio-psycho-social condition. It is important to us that we address it as such and this comprehensive approach is one of our core differentiators.

I (Celine) started the company because I grew up around pancreatic cancer patients, who were experiencing excruciating pain. People close to me passed away from morphine overdose and not even the cancer itself. I saw how pain affected someone not just physically, but also psychologically and socially.
